desc:
Watch this video ad-free on Nebula: https://nebula.tv/videos/not-just-bikes-car-free-streets-are-amazing-and-we-need-more-of-them

Autoluw is a Dutch urban planning concept meaning "nearly car-free". It's put into use all over the country, and has resulted in some of the greatest urban environments I've ever been to.

This video explores the concept of autoluw, and how it is applied to Dutch stree
